description: Java class LimitedInputStream that wraps an InputStream to limit the number of bytes read, based on Guava's implementation.

classes.name: LimitedInputStream
classes.description: A final class extending FilterInputStream that limits the number of bytes that can be read from the underlying InputStream.

methods.name: LimitedInputStream
methods.description: Constructor initializing the stream with a limit and whether to close the wrapped stream.

methods.name: available
methods.description: Returns the minimum of the underlying stream's available bytes and the remaining limit.

methods.name: mark
methods.description: Marks the current position in the stream and saves the remaining byte limit.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a single byte, decrementing the limit if successful.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads bytes into a buffer, respecting the remaining limit.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the stream to the last marked position and restores the byte limit.

methods.name: skip
methods.description: Skips bytes, respecting the remaining limit.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the stream if configured to do so.
